summary.text: Tidal power, or tidal energy, converts the energy of the tides into useful forms of power, mainly electricity.
Tides are driven by the gravity of the Moon and Sun and by Earth's rotation, so they are highly regular and more predictable than wind or sunshine.
Power is taken either from moving tidal currents that spin turbines or from the height difference between high and low tide, held back by dams called barrages.

facts.label: Energy source
facts.value: Mainly the orbits of the Earth–Moon system

facts.label: Length of a day
facts.value: Grew from 21.9 to 24 hours in 620 million years

items.prompt: Wind, solar, wave and fossil fuel energy all trace back to the Sun. Where does tidal power's energy mainly come from?

options.label: The orbits of the Earth and Moon

items.explain: Tidal power is the only technology drawing on energy in the orbital characteristics of the Earth–Moon system, and less so the Earth–Sun system.

items.prompt: The tides slowly drain energy from the spinning Earth–Moon system. What has this done to Earth's days over its history?
items.explain: The lost energy has slowed Earth's rotation, stretching the day from 21.9 to 24 hours over the last 620 million years.

items.prompt: Engineers are comparing coastal sites for a new tidal power plant. Which feature most raises a site's potential?

options.label: Lots of sunshine through the year
A big rise and fall of the tide

items.explain: Greater tidal variation and faster tidal currents can dramatically increase a site's potential for tidal electricity.

items.prompt: A dam across an estuary lets the rising sea fill a large basin behind it. When does it send that water through its turbines?

options.label: At the very peak of high tide
As the tide goes back out

items.explain: A barrage stores incoming tidal water in a basin, then releases it through turbines as the tide recedes.

items.prompt: A grid operator must plan power supply weeks ahead. Why can tidal output be forecast better than wind output?

options.label: Tides follow the regular Moon and Earth cycle
Tidal turbines never need to shut down
Seawater flows at the same speed all day
Tidal plants store all of their power

items.explain: Tides are highly regular and predictable because of the steady pattern of Earth's rotation and the Moon's orbit.

items.prompt: A tidal stream generator uses the motion of the sea to spin blades. Which familiar machine works in much the same way?
items.explain: Tidal stream generators use the kinetic energy of moving water to power turbines, much as wind turbines use the wind.
